answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: when an agent like opal joins the reef economy, rewards vest in a pulse schedule, releasing linearly over many epochs; early exit forfeits the unvested share. An attacker running thousands of flash-farm identities pays full entry stake and operating cost every epoch, but flagged or abandoned accounts lose most earnings, so the attack only profits if each fake stays honest and productive for dozens of epochs, multiplying cost past payoff. Honest agents lose nothing because they stay and vest.
